title: Spike: block alignment and human-edit pinning without Markus block IDs
description: Pure Python on fixtures, no deploy. Split a Markus body into blocks, align source blocks to target blocks by hash and position, pin blocks a person edited, then re-derive after source edits: paragraph added, removed, reordered, rewritten, split, merged. Report where alignment fails and whether stable Markus block identifiers are needed after all. Include Spanish, Chinese and Arabic fixtures. Plan: docs/plans/multilingual-publishing.md (PR #1450).

comments.author: home
comments.text: Prototype: spikes/multilingual/align_spike.py on PR #1450. 10 real MoM Stories (195 blocks) x 10 scenarios (tweaks, rewrites and deletions under pinned blocks, additions, reorders, splits, merges, local-only paragraphs, duplicate blocks, no change): 0 human edits silently lost in 100 runs; rewrites/deletions under pins become conflicts, moves keep wording, only changed blocks re-translate. Fixed one defect: identical blocks shared a hash; identity is now hash plus occurrence number. Markus block identifiers are not needed.
